visual_grammar.medium_handling: Large atlas/relic plates in the same graphite-silverpoint-additive-pigment world as the lattice, but freed from any single virtue color. Named figures, artifacts, moons, gates, texts, and places may draw whichever Principle channels they genuinely require.
visual_grammar.composition: One proper noun anchors the plate at mythic/diagrammatic scale, surrounded by enough cube, lunar, geographic, or ritual construction to locate it in Britannia's cosmology. The anchor remains concrete—person, object, place, event—rather than dissolving into pure numerology.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Strong emblematic silhouette or architectural/artifact contour over visible drafting geometry; colored channel traces and silver lunar edges may enter as relational structure rather than ornament.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Graphite field with one dominant named anchor, selective virtue-channel color, and station-controlled silver illumination. High contrast is earned by cosmological importance, not applied uniformly.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Atlas/icon scale: larger and more centered than minor plates, but still materially inspectable as an artifact/site/figure in a drawn world rather than a cinematic fantasy shot.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Specific proper-noun attributes, runes, mechanisms, landscape or ritual objects carry local detail; surrounding lattice/astronomical construction stays schematic.
visual_grammar.finish: Britannian cosmological index—spare, iconic, tactile, diagrammatic, and mythic without losing the color-cube instrument beneath the world.
avoid: virtue-color palette swaps for unrelated proper nouns
pure abstract numerology with no concrete named anchor

factorization.gloss: Zero — the Avatar begins as the open receiver of the quest: no virtue claimed as possession, no fixed role, the empty coordinate through which the lattice can be traversed.
factorization.visual_logic: Hold a human-shaped absence or uncolored center inside the larger cube/world diagram. The frame should be organized by a place waiting to be occupied rather than by an already completed heroic identity.

factorization.gloss: One — Lord British is the initiating operator: the sovereign act that names the quest, establishes the realm's coordinate system, and sets virtue into motion without itself being one of the eight suit-values.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one axial sovereign line—throne, staff, decree, or central meridian—from which surrounding routes or lattice coordinates become ordered.

factorization.gloss: Two — the Guardian is an irreducible adversarial will: domination presented as a single indivisible red force against which the realm must define itself.
factorization.visual_logic: Build one bilateral opposition—Guardian/world, hand/gate, red force/graphite realm—around a hard dividing axis. Do not diffuse the threat into many equal villains.

factorization.gloss: Three — the Codex is an irreducible statement of wisdom: Truth, Love, and Courage may all be read through it, yet the answer is not merely their checklist but a singular whole one descends to meet.
factorization.visual_logic: Use a stable triangular or three-ray construction converging on one book/answer. The triad must produce a single center rather than three separate labeled panels.

factorization.gloss: Four = two squared. The Ankh is life/persistence given stable form: an enduring sign whose fourfold compositional structure counterpoints the Guardian's raw dyadic force without pretending the symbol is semantically descended from him.
factorization.visual_logic: Square a bilateral energy into a four-corner frame around the Ankh's living center. The formal ancestry is 2²; the named symbol remains the semantic anchor.

factorization.gloss: Five — Trammel is prime constancy: the inner moon as a fixed navigational fact, irreducible law and steady reference against Felucca's change.
factorization.visual_logic: Let one self-contained lunar orbit or fivefold field resolve around a single steady moon. Its formal point is singular constancy, not busy astronomical counting.

factorization.gloss: Six = two times three. Felucca combines force and patterned wisdom as passage: a moving moon whose cycle turns cosmic difference into navigable gates and opportunities.
factorization.visual_logic: Interlock a two-pole gate relation with a three-part cycle/trajectory to produce sixfold motion. The form should visibly open passage rather than settle into static symmetry.

factorization.gloss: Seven — Mondain is prime refusal: the first dark will that will not accept mortality, indivisible in its hoarding of power and therefore unable to transform through relation.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one sealed dark core, monolith, wizard/gem axis, or closed heptagonal orbit that visually refuses exchange with the surrounding field.

factorization.gloss: Eight = two cubed. Minax intensifies the Guardian's relation-to-control recursively until domination operates through inheritance, time, enchantment, and desire rather than direct force alone.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest three levels of paired/mirrored structure—heir/source, now/then, desire/control—so repeated dyads become a cubic or recursive temporal enclosure.

factorization.gloss: Nine = three squared. Exodus takes the Codex's knowledge-like ordering and squares it into pure system: intelligence recursively formalized until the machine no longer needs a human soul.
factorization.visual_logic: Use a 3×3 circuit/grid or one triadic logic nested inside another around the daemon-engine. Precision should feel self-perpetuating and inhuman.

factorization.gloss: Ten = two times five. Falsehood appears when coercive force meets fixed reference and bends it into an imposed certainty: a lie made durable enough to walk as law.
factorization.visual_logic: Set two opposed claims across a fivefold/fixed organizing frame, then let one falsely occupy the axis of certainty. The composition should show distortion of reference rather than random deception.

factorization.gloss: Eleven — Hatred is prime negation of Love: an indivisible refusal of relation that cannot be repaired by subdividing it into lesser irritations.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one clean severance or repulsive center that pushes relational geometry outward. The whole plate should answer to a single refusal-to-connect.

factorization.gloss: Twelve = four times three. Cowardice takes stabilized structure and subjects it to a three-way demand—self, danger, duty—until the frame organizes itself around retreat rather than courageous passage.
factorization.visual_logic: Build a four-square/secure enclosure crossed by three directional demands, with the active path collapsing backward into shelter. The composite should read as structured retreat, not generic fear.

factorization.gloss: Thirteen — the Stygian Abyss is prime descent: the final trial gathers every virtue, but the passage itself is irreducible and must be entered as one whole ordeal.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one uncompromising downward shaft/path through the graphite field. Other symbols may accumulate along it, but no alternate route should dilute the singular descent.

factorization.gloss: Fourteen = two times seven. The Word of Power couples directed force with forbidden/ancient potency: the earned utterance turns gathered syllables into one operative opening of the Abyss.
factorization.visual_logic: Arrange a two-register utterance across a seven-step/descent rhythm so multiple syllables resolve into one active word/gate-opening vector rather than decorative text.

factorization.gloss: Fifteen = three times five. The Black Gate combines patterned knowledge with fixed cosmic reference to form a threshold that appears orderly and inevitable even as it admits ruin.
factorization.visual_logic: Cross a triadic construction with a stable fivefold/orbital frame around one dark aperture. The geometry should look persuasive and lawful while the center remains catastrophic.

factorization.gloss: Sixteen = two to the fourth. The Time Lord is control recursively structured through repeated binary branches until relation becomes an architecture of possible timelines and right timing.
factorization.visual_logic: Nest four levels of paired temporal branch, clock/gate, or before/after structure around one observer. Repetition should produce temporal architecture rather than visual clutter.

factorization.gloss: Seventeen — Bell, Book, and Candle form a paradoxically prime ritual key: three concrete instruments are experienced as one indivisible readiness, because remove any one and the opening fails.
factorization.visual_logic: Arrange the three objects as one tightly bound chord/triangle whose negative space forms a single operative key. The prime character belongs to their inseparability, not to object count.

factorization.gloss: Eighteen = two times three squared. The Fellowship multiplies coercive relation by a self-reinforcing doctrinal system: counterfeit community becomes a mirrored apparatus that captures trust in repeated ideological frames.
factorization.visual_logic: Use two mirrored 3×3 social/doctrinal matrices or equivalent paired recursive triads, with people visibly absorbed into the repeated structure rather than freely relating.

factorization.gloss: Nineteen — the Quest of the Avatar is prime becoming: no checklist or external destination substitutes for the irreducible act of becoming a virtuous self through the journey.
factorization.visual_logic: Use one unbroken pilgrimage path/gesture through multiple virtue traces. The route may cross every color, but composition remains one continuous becoming rather than eight separate tasks.

factorization.gloss: Twenty = four times five. The Gem of Immortality fixes power inside a stable multiplied frame until one object can fracture the world: persistence made structure, then overconcentrated into a brittle center.
factorization.visual_logic: Set a fourfold structural frame against a fivefold orbital/fixed rhythm around one gem, then visibly fracture the composite geometry outward into mirrored lands.

factorization.gloss: Twenty-one = three times seven. Britannia is composite totality: a triadic Principle structure carried through a sevenfold formal rhythm into one inhabited realm whose many systems become a world rather than a diagram.
factorization.visual_logic: Use a 3×7 underlying construction only as hidden organizing scaffold beneath a concrete map/realm image. The viewer should feel integrated multiplicity without the world collapsing into a multiplication table.
